title: feat(sync-in): the windowed read of a datasource source, and a row-cap refusal that carries what came back (ADR-0153 D2)
body:
Part of #32062

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — this slice changes nothing an author writes or sees (the reader is not reachable from `job.pull` yet); the sync-in skills update is ADR-0153's P3 guide + skills child

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：同步导入（sync-in）引擎的第一片：联邦对象作数据源时的分窗读取器（内置驱动按键分页、插件驱动经引擎地板读取并对半切窗），以及行数上限拒绝在错误对象上私下携带驱动返回的行；补救文案从已退役的 DataSync 改指 sync-in。
- 为什么改：ADR-0153 D2 规定拉取必须读完每一行、只在窗口结束时提交位置；这是 P2 引擎卡的地基，后续切片在其上接 `job.pull`、运行记录、删除标记与来源列。
- 风险与回滚：读取器本片尚无调用者，不会拉取任何 `datasourceSource` 映射；唯一运行时可见变化是行数上限拒绝的提示文案。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-automation/src/datasource-window-read.ts`（`floored()` 的对半切窗与两个拒绝、`commitWindow` 的提交值）、`packages/objectql/src/external-driver-errors.ts`（私有字段携带返回行）、`datasource-window-read.test.ts` 的 5000/5400/6200 用例。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/datasource-window-read.test.ts`，预期 25 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The first slice of the sync-in P2 engine (ADR-0153's 〈P2 engine〉 row): the windowed read a datasource source's pull is built on, and the floor payload it needs. Nothing calls the reader yet; the next slice wires it to `job.pull`.

- **`ExternalRowCapExceededError` carries what came back** (`packages/objectql/src/external-driver-errors.ts`, `external-driver-floor.ts`). The floor still refuses exactly the reads it refused before. The error object now answers `returnedRowCount` and `returnedValuesOf(field)` over the rows the driver returned, held in a private class field: never in `details`, never an own enumerable key, never in a serialization (the engine's own `WARN Find operation failed` line logs `message` and `stack` only, measured in the test run). The prescription points at sync-in instead of the retired DataSync (ADR-0153's P2 engine row).
- **The windowed read** (`packages/services/service-automation/src/datasource-window-read.ts`), both read paths of D1, every D2 invariant the reader owns:
  - canon-aligned bounds compared with `$gte` and `$lt` only (invariants 3, 4); a value read back is floored to the step (millisecond, day, integer) by truncation before it bounds anything, and no watermark value is ever a page cursor (5);
  - **built-in driver**: the run-start high-water read `H0` (one `max(field)` over the whole source under the organization conjunct, spelled as a descending read of one row on a non-null field), bounded windows only below `floor(H0)` (12), each paged by the source key until a short page, one more high-water read `H1` before the open-above window;
  - **floored plugin driver**: the open-above window first; over the cap, bounded windows only below the largest value the answer showed, halved while over the cap; `sync_window_unsplittable` when one canon step holds more than the cap, `sync_bounds_not_pushed` when a returned value lies outside the window (the organization equality is not part of that judgement);
  - commit only at a window's end (8), at the floor of the smaller of the largest watermark value written and, on a built-in window read in several pages, the high-water value read before its first page (9); a run that writes nothing commits nothing;
  - the organization conjunct on every read, the high-water reads included (10);
  - run-time exactness (7): a key or an integer watermark read back outside ±2^53 refuses the run (`source_key_not_exact`, `watermark_not_exact`, the build's own tokens, verbatim); a `watermark.start` the field's kind does not read refuses with `watermark_start_invalid`.
- **`ConnectorPullError`** moves into `pull-refusal.ts` so the reader throws the same type without importing the connector executor; `connector-pull.ts` and the package root still export it.
- Tuning ADR-0153 leaves to this child, decided here: built-in, the bounded region starts as 8 equal windows, a window read in one page doubles the next and one read in more than 8 pages halves it, 1,000 rows per page; floored, the whole bounded region is tried as one window, halved on an over-cap answer, and the next window doubles the width that answered.

### Proposed slice order for #32062

1. **This PR** — the windowed read, the floor payload and remedy, the two floored refusals and the run-time exactness refusals.
2. `sys_sync_run` (D7) with its writer and the committed read position, the interrupted-run close and the end-of-pull `info` line; the datasource pull wired into `pullConnectorSource` and the runtime binder's `judgeJobPull`; D8's organization predicate and `source_organization_scope_unstated`; the carrier note's run-time edges (a source with no declared `id`, a sourced mapping in a stack with no objects); `datasourceSource` liveness rows flipped `live`. Blocked on the contract question in the report (the pull result's shape for a datasource source).
3. D4 provenance: the `_sync_` plan rows, stamping, the `_sync_` write refusal and the purge.
4. D3 delete marking (completeness rule, range limit, NULL-watermark count), the incremental-`mark` refusal, the connector paging loop with its one commit after the last page; `paging` / `deletePolicy` / `deletedField` rows flipped.
5. D6's three drift arms and the record-level watermark refusal.
6. D8 at boot and at the install route, `JOB_ORGANIZATION_DESCRIPTION`, the per-dialect client verification in the driver-sql live matrix (a Postgres one-statement microsecond stamp, a row at .9996 ms, a 64-bit key and watermark), and the plugin-driver conformance kit's windowed-read cases. This last slice carries the closing line for the card.

## Tests

- `datasource-window-read.test.ts` — 25 cases through the real engine: the floored path behind the real floor (`external.rowCap: 4`, a plugin driver double that pushes equalities and the bounds its mode names, answers in reverse order and stops at the sent limit), the built-in path on the SQL driver over a federated SQLite table with `columnMap` onto `id`. Among them the ADR's listed cases this slice can run: a run interrupted after page one, a row behind the key cursor updated during the open-above window, committed 5000 / maximum 5400 / writes of 5401 to 6200 during the run on both paths, more rows than a page sharing one millisecond, a 64-bit key and a 64-bit integer watermark on SQLite, and the canon floor of a value at .9996 of a millisecond. Every refusal asserts `code` + `status` + `reason`.
- `external-driver-floor.test.ts` — the payload is on the error and in no serialization; the remedy names sync-in and not DataSync.

## Acceptance notes

- The reader is not reachable from any door in this slice, so no liveness row flips here; `datasourceSource` and its children stay `planned` with `authorWarn` until slice 2 wires the pull.
- Each over-cap read during halving is logged by the engine's find middleware as one `WARN Find operation failed` with the refusal's message and stack. A large source halved many times writes many of these lines. Recorded as an open question in the report, not changed here.
- `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts` still describes the row-cap remedy as "mirror the data with DataSync" in a code comment. Not edited: this lane makes no `packages/spec/src/**` change. Carrier: the slice that next touches that file.
- SQLite measurement: better-sqlite3 (no `safeIntegers`) reads a 64-bit `INTEGER` past 2^53 as a rounded JavaScript number; the run-time refusal is what keeps such a key or watermark from becoming a bound or a cursor. Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server and Oracle client defaults are NOT MEASURED here (no server in this container); they ride slice 6 on CI's live dialect matrix.
